stock.description: China Anchu Energy Storage Group Ltd. primarily focuses on the manufacturing and marketing of men's apparel. The company's operations are structured into three distinct divisions: Menswear Apparel, Industrial Products, and Energy Storage Battery. Its menswear offerings include a range of items such as trousers, tops, and various accessories for men. Kin Sun Kwok established the company on December 23, 2013, and it maintains its corporate headquarters in Quanzhou, China.
